focus: Miami and Miami-addressed areas of Miami-Dade County (Brickell, Downtown, Edgewater, Upper East Side, Health District, Coconut Grove, Coral Way, West Flagler, the airport area, Dadeland, Bird Road, Westchester, Kendall, Sweetwater, West Kendall, the Hammocks, and the Palmetto Bay and Doral areas)
intro: This first Miami page covers 20 UPS Store locations with Miami street addresses whose official location and mailbox-services pages list staffed hours and package acceptance from all carriers — from Brickell, Downtown, Edgewater, and the Upper East Side to Coconut Grove, Coral Way, Westchester, Kendall, and the Hammocks. 16 of them publish Sunday hours. Two stores, Brickell (936 SW 1st Ave) and Downtown (153 E Flagler St), say on their own pages that mailbox holders get an access card to collect mail any time of day; the other stores mention 24-hour access only at participating locations, so that flag is off for them. Several stores are in unincorporated Miami-Dade areas that use a Miami mailing address. It is not a complete inventory: independent pack-and-ship stores, Miami Beach, Coral Gables, Hialeah, and Doral proper are not covered yet. Box availability can change; treat it as something to confirm. If you cannot get to a storefront, compare virtual mailbox services.

listings.name: The UPS Store — 936 SW 1st Ave
listings.area: Brickell · SW 1st Ave (across from Brickell Metrorail)

hours.notes: Staffed store hours from the official location page’s opening-hours data. Holiday hours can differ; the page lists Thanksgiving Day (November 26) as closed.

listings.carriersNotes: The official mailbox-services page for this store says mailbox customers get package acceptance from all carriers, plus mail holding and forwarding. It does not list carrier names. Confirm any size or signing limits with the store.
listings.visitNotes: The mailbox-services page for this store says mailbox customers get an access card to pick up mail any time of the day, and that large packages and overflow mail are held for pickup during regular business hours. Box availability is not published as live inventory. Confirm with the store that a box is actually open.
